description: This file contains test helper functions and utilities for testing the gateway server, including WebSocket connection handling, server startup, session management, and environment setup.

methods.name: getServerModule
methods.description: Lazily imports and caches the server module.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTestMainSessionKeys
methods.description: Resolves main session keys based on current config and test state.

methods.name: serializeGatewayTestSessionConfig
methods.description: Serializes current test session configuration to JSON string.

methods.name: hasUnsyncedGatewayTestSessionConfig
methods.description: Checks if current session config has unsynced changes.

methods.name: persistTestSessionConfig
methods.description: Persists current test session configuration to files.

methods.name: writeSessionStore
methods.description: Writes session store data to the configured path.

methods.name: setupGatewayTestHome
methods.description: Sets up environment and directories for gateway tests.

methods.name: applyGatewaySkipEnv
methods.description: Sets environment variables to skip certain gateway components during tests.

methods.name: resetGatewayTestState
methods.description: Resets the test environment and state for gateway tests.

methods.name: cleanupGatewayTestHome
methods.description: Cleans up environment and directories after gateway tests.

methods.name: installGatewayTestHooks
methods.description: Installs test hooks for gateway test setup and teardown.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Returns a deterministic free port for testing.

methods.name: occupyPort
methods.description: Occupies a port by starting a server to prevent reuse.

methods.name: getTrackedConnectChallengeNonce
methods.description: Retrieves the tracked connect challenge nonce from a WebSocket.

methods.name: trackConnectChallengeNonce
methods.description: Tracks connect challenge nonces on WebSocket messages.

methods.name: onceMessage
methods.description: Waits for a specific message matching a filter from WebSocket.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Starts the gateway server on a specified port.

methods.name: startGatewayServerWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to start the gateway server with retries on port conflicts.

methods.name: waitForWebSocketOpen
methods.description: Waits for a WebSocket connection to open.

methods.name: openTrackedWebSocket
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection and tracks connect challenge nonce.

methods.name: withGatewayServer
methods.description: Runs a function with a temporary gateway server instance.

methods.name: createGatewaySuiteHarness
methods.description: Creates a test harness with a running gateway server.

methods.name: startServerWithClient
methods.description: Starts a gateway server and connects a client WebSocket.

methods.name: startConnectedServerWithClient
methods.description: Starts a server and connects a client WebSocket, then performs handshake.

methods.name: resolveDefaultTestDeviceIdentityPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for device identity JSON.

methods.name: readConnectChallengeNonce
methods.description: Reads the connect challenge nonce from WebSocket messages.

methods.name: resolveAuthTokenForSignature
methods.description: Resolves the authentication token for device signature.

methods.name: testOnlyResolveAuthTokenForSignature
methods.description: Test utility to resolve auth token for signature.

methods.name: connectReq
methods.description: Performs a connect request over WebSocket with device auth.

methods.name: connectOk
methods.description: Performs connect request and asserts success.

methods.name: connectWebchatClient
methods.description: Connects a WebSocket client for webchat testing.

methods.name: rpcReq
methods.description: Sends an RPC request over WebSocket and waits for response.

methods.name: waitForSystemEvent
methods.description: Waits for a system event within a timeout.
